name: Elle
source:
"Elle's all about having fun. Pain and hardship? Boring~"

Elle is one of four "Yama" (Night Demons) who have appeared in Ouma City. She is a playful and youthful girl called "Kaiki" (Wandering Ogre) by local exorcists.

She exhibits a cheerful and carefree demeanor, characterized by rapidly shifting and unpredictable moods akin to a typhoon. Her golden rule? If it's not fun, it's not worth doing. This devotion to hedonism sets her apart, as she pursues joy with unmatched zeal. Still, don't be fooled by her apparent airheadedness. Behind the facade, Elle's mind is razor-sharp.

Even among other Night Demons, Elle stands out with her extraordinary regenerative abilities and physical strength. In battle, she wields an illegally modified chainsaw with surprising ease.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/sen_nagi/chara03.html]official website[/url]]
